title: Argentinian Autumn Apple Empanadas
description: A vegan twist on traditional Argentinean empanadas, filled with the sweetness of autumnal apples.

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.notes: any mix of autumnal apples (granny smith, honeycrisp)

instructions: Roll out empanada dough to about 1/8-inch thickness.
In a bowl, mix together sliced apples, maple syrup, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Place about 1 tablespoon of the apple mixture onto one half of the dough circle.
Brush edges with melted vegan butter.
Fold dough in half to form a half-circle and press edges to seal.
Use a fork to crimp edges and create a decorative border.
Repeat with remaining dough and filling.
Place empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Optional: dust with powdered sugar before serving.
